items.title: Can Scotland’s Abundant Wind Power a Data Center Boom?
items.title_ko: Can Scotland’s Abundant Wind Power a Data Center Boom?
items.summary_ko: Scotland produces far more wind power than its grid can handle, forcing turbines to be shut down when supply exceeds demand or transmission capacity. Developers now see a possible solution: build data centers close to the surplus power, turning wasted wind into compute capacity for AI and the digital economy.
